inclusion_criteria: Confirmed diagnosis of Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus for at least 1 year
Stable dose of metformin for at least 3 months prior to screening
Willing to perform self-monitoring of blood glucose
exclusion_criteria: eGFR less than or equal to 60 mL/min/1.73m²
History of diabetic ketoacidosis within past 12 months
Pregnant, nursing, or planning pregnancy during trial period
Active malignancy or cancer treatment within past 5 years
Uncontrolled hypertension (systolic > 160 mmHg or diastolic > 100 mmHg)
Current use of any SGLT2 inhibitor
Use of any investigational drug within 30 days of screening
History of recurrent urinary tract infections (3 or more in past year)
primary_endpoint: Change in HbA1c from baseline at Week 26
